sam-sec: Incoming pentest from Northlight confirmed for 2024-09-10. Need final intake: scope, RBAC pattern, KMS policy for exported artifacts, retention, and retest window. Can we decide today?

jordan-eng: Quick notes: scope = staging APIs + analytics pipeline (ingest->transform). No production creds or customer PII in exported bundles. For RBAC we should provide an "assessor-reader" role that can list/get from specific buckets and read ingest API metrics. No write permissions.

lee-sre: Observability package proposal: logs + traces + metrics subset. Export fields: timestamp, service, trace_id, request_id, principal_hash, action, resource, status_code, latency_ms, error. Sampling: 100% for auth and errors, 1% for normal traffic by default. Retention of export artifacts: 120 days in PT bucket. We'll run redaction to remove ip_address, email, and any customer_text fields.

maria-gov: KMS constraints: cannot grant kms:Decrypt to external accounts. Offer envelope encryption with a service key. We can support a readroom process for one-off decrypt with dual-approval and MFA; that'll produce a signed audit artifact showing who requested and who approved. Key policy snippet will be added to the ticket.

sam-sec: Intake decision: no direct decrypt access. Provide encrypted archives + redacted logs + readroom for any plaintext with 2-person approval and timeboxed access. Also require assessor to sign an NDA and data handling statement.

jordan-eng: I'll file REDINF-1300 and attach the checklist and automation plan. I'll also add a terraform snippet to create the assessor role and an IAM policy that only allows s3:GetObject on `pt-exports/northlight/*` and sts:AssumeRole for a limited role. Proposed script:

```bash
./infra/create_assessor.sh --name northlight --duration 4h --bucket pt-exports/northlight
```

evidence-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pentest-evidence-packaging. Required manifest fields: exported_at, exporter, file_list, checksum, schema_version. Packaging tool: `tools/pt-pack --src /var/logs/pt --out s3://pt-exports/northlight/manifest.zip`.

lee-sre: KMS detail: Use kms:GenerateDataKey (Encrypt) allowed for upload, kms:Decrypt denied. For readroom ephemeral decrypt we'll use `kms:Decrypt` executed by a central ops principal under audited approval flow; the decrypt action will log requestor, approver, and JIRA ticket ID.

maria-gov: Compliance note: ensure the readroom flow generates an integrity proof (hash of original encrypted file + audit trail). We'll store audit proofs in a separate path `s3://pt-exports/audit-proofs/northlight/`.

sam-sec: Turnaround SLAs: curated artifacts (manifest + packaged export) = 12 hours. On-call support for live telemetry captures / quick sampling = 2 hours for acknowledgement, target delivery within 6 hours. Is that feasible?

jordan-eng: 12h looks tight but OK if request during business hours. I'll add escalation steps in REDINF-1300. Also scheduling: propose retest window Tue 2024-09-17 10:00-14:00 PDT. I'll send calendar invites when ticket is updated.

lee-sre: Ops pre-check (to include in runbook):
1) run `./verification/check-assessor-role.sh northlight`
2) run `./tools/export-logs --start 2024-09-10T00:00Z --end 2024-09-10T06:00Z --fields=timestamp,service,trace_id,request_id,principal_hash,action,resource,status_code --out /tmp/northlight-sample.zip`
3) run `tools/pt-pack --src /tmp/northlight-sample.zip --out s3://pt-exports/northlight/`

maria-gov: I'll review the key-policy PR and the readroom SOP. We should also prepare a short ingress questionnaire for Northlight: requested scopes, samples needed, contact + emergency contact, expected repro steps.

sam-sec: Great. I'll draft the intake doc (link to be posted) listing: scope, RBAC role, KMS policy decision (no decrypt), retention, redaction rules, SLAs, readroom flow, retest window. Ping me on the doc for signoff. Thanks team :raised_hands:
